title: Work & interviews — B1
description: Frases y vocabulario para entrevistas de trabajo y contexto profesional.

vocab.example: Could you tell me about your background?
My biggest achievement was leading the migration.
One of my strengths is problem-solving.
I'm working on my public speaking as a weakness.
I handle pressure by planning ahead.
She always takes initiative on new projects.
We aligned all stakeholders before launch.
There's always a trade-off between speed and quality.
We investigated the root cause of the outage.
We had to push back to avoid scope creep.
The onboarding process takes two weeks.
I'd like to raise a concern about the timeline.

listening.text: Tell me about a challenging project you worked on recently.
Where do you see yourself in five years?
How do you handle conflict within a team?

speaking.target: I have five years of experience building backend systems in Node and Go.
My proudest achievement was reducing our deployment time by half.
Answer: 'Why do you want to work here?'

writing.prompt: Write a short answer (60-80 words) to: 'What is your greatest strength and how have you applied it?'

grammar.title: Present perfect for experience
grammar.explanation: have/has + past participle. Se usa para experiencias sin fecha específica ('I have worked with...').
examples: I have worked with React for three years.

practice.prompt: Complete: I ___ (work) on similar projects before.
